name.description: Agent Plugins v1.0.0 name: 1-64 chars, a-z 0-9 - . only, no '--' or '..'

publisher.description: Your GitHub username — must match the PR author for auto-merge. Display value only; ownership is keyed on publisher_id.

publisher_id.description: Your numeric GitHub account id — the immutable ownership key. Logins can be renamed and re-registered by someone else; this number cannot. Required once an entry records one.

version.description: SemVer; must strictly increase on updates

plugin_json.description: kind=plugin: the Agent Plugins v1.0.0 plugin.json, Jarvis specifics under extensions['io.github.personaljarvis']

mcp_json.description: kind=plugin: optional mcp.json with exactly one streamable-http or pinned stdio server; never credentials

skills.description: kind=plugin: skills the package bundles (Agent Plugins skills/). Instructions only — no scripts/, and no risk_policy in the frontmatter.

name.description: Becomes a directory under the user's skills folder

usage_card.description: kind=plugin: optional markdown card (frontmatter 'keywords:' line + guidance prose)

skill_md.description: kind=skill: the complete SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter + instructions)

flavor.description: kind=skill: which frontmatter the SKILL.md carries — 'jarvis' uses the app's schema (triggers, execution mode), 'portable' is a plain Agent Skill that also installs into other agents via `npx skills add`. Optional: derived from the file when omitted.

compatible_agents.description: kind=skill: agents you have run this skill in, e.g. ['Claude Code', 'Cursor']. Display only — shown on the store card.

license.description: kind=wallpaper: the license the image is redistributed under — the feed serves the file to every install, so it must permit exactly that

theme.description: kind=wallpaper: which UI mode the picture suits; recomputed from luminance at build time when omitted
